    Mesh corrections for periodic models of type A #

    Appendix A, "Types A and D" (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex): "When the twist is trivial … we may root the path at an endpoint and regard it as a star with one arm … For the reflection of A_{2n-1}, rooted at its middle vertex, the two closed paths at the centre are x and -x, and reflection sends x to -x."
